description: Use this when the user wants the transcript, comments, metadata, video/audio files or structured JSON from a video, post or web page. Starts an extraction on the user's Post Reef account (debits its credits; refunded if it fails) and waits up to wait_seconds for the result. Pass schemaId or schema for JSON, otherwise it is a download. Call quote first if the user wants to know the cost.

force.description: Run fresh even if an identical extraction from the last 30 days could be reused for free.

inputs.description: AI runs (with schemaId or schema): what the model reads. Any of transcript, comments, audio, video. Default transcript + comments. Do not combine with parts.

maxComments.description: Cap on how many comments to fetch (1-1000, default 1000).

parts.description: Download-only runs (no schema): which artifacts to fetch. Any of transcript, comments, audio, video. Omit for all of them. Metadata, thumbnail and description always come back.

schema.description: Inline JSON Schema (top-level object) for the extracted JSON, instead of schemaId. No type unions; enums of strings only; optional fields are simply left out of required.

schemaId.description: Turn the content into JSON with a saved schema: a predefined one by name (Recipe, Workout, Product review, …) or id, or one of the user's own schema ids. See list_schemas.

url.description: Public link to one video, post or web page (YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Vimeo, an article, …).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning (0-50, default 45). If it is not done by then, call get_extraction.

name: extract
title: Extract from a link
